summary: Verified lead form submissions across all listed endpoints and CRM webhook forwarding. Created pytest suite (12 tests) covering /api/quick-enquiry, /api/counselling-leads, /api/contact, /api/summer-training-leads, /api/industrial-training-leads, /api/cyber-warriors/register, /api/educonnect/enquiry, /api/hire-request, /api/franchise-enquiries, /api/referrals + a CRM-timing test. All 12 pass (100%). Backend logs confirm 'CRM webhook sent: <name> (<source>)' fires for every source. Additionally ran Playwright UI tests on HeroForm (home), FreeCounsellingForm (/free-counselling), ContactForm (/contact) and SummerTraining landing form — every form returned 200 and HeroForm + FreeCounselling successfully redirected to /thank-you. CRM logs also captured 'TEST UI Hero', 'TEST UI FreeCoun', 'TEST UI Contact', 'TEST UI Summer' (Contact Form) confirming end-to-end submission+forwarding through the browser.

issues: Next.js console warnings on logo images (/images/logo-blue.png and logo-white.png): 'width or height modified, but not the other' — cosmetic, not a functional bug

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4800+ lines — should be split into modules (leads, admin, programs, etc.) per code review guideline (>700 lines).

send_lead_to_crm() is awaited synchronously inside each POST handler. External timeout is 10s + 1 retry (+1s sleep) = worst case ~21s of extra latency added to the user-facing form response. Consider firing it as asyncio.create_task(...) (fire-and-forget) so form responses are always fast even when the CRM is slow/down. Currently mitigated by short timeout but still adds latency on failures.
CRM_WEBHOOK_URL is read once at import time from env; if env changes, backend needs restart (acceptable).
Franchise/Referral endpoints exist and forward to CRM correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test lead records with names prefixed TEST_ / 'TEST UI' were inserted into MongoDB collections quick_enquiries, counselling_leads, contact_enquiries, summer_training_leads, industrial_training_leads, cyber_warriors_registrations, educonnect_enquiries, hire_requests, franchise_enquiries, referrals. Should be cleaned up by main agent before production or via admin panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_lead_forms.py hits ALL lead endpoints and verifies both 2xx response and 'CRM webhook sent' log line via _wait_and_check_crm_log(). CRM webhook is real (bms.etieducom.com); tests accept both 'sent' and 'failed' outcomes as long as send_lead_to_crm was invoked. Correct routes: /api/cyber-warriors/register (not /registrations), /api/educonnect/enquiry (not /enquiries).
rca of the issue: Original user bug 'lead forms not working across course/home pages' was resolved by main agent setting CRM_WEBHOOK_URL env var and restarting backend. Verification: (a) backend endpoint POST /api/quick-enquiry, /api/counselling-leads, /api/contact, /api/summer-training-leads, etc. all return 200; (b) send_lead_to_crm() successfully POSTs to https://bms.etieducom.com/api/webhooks/leads/... and logs 'CRM webhook sent: <name> (<source>)'; (c) UI Playwright automation confirms HeroForm on homepage, FreeCounsellingForm on /free-counselling, ContactForm on /contact, and SummerTraining landing form submit and (where applicable) redirect to /thank-you page. No blocking issues found.
